note: 25-delta bracket rows. Quotes are BSM midpoints of the stated 6-decimal sigma (4-decimal bid/ask, spread 0.002). Expected IV25 = delta-linear interpolation between the first bracketing pair scanning outward from the ATM strike (R-04, R-09, R-10, R-21); delta = spot delta e^{-qT}N(+-d1) at the contract own sigma. Brackets and weights are oracle information only (not output keys). Tolerance IV 1e-4.
